source.note: Expected identifiers and descriptions were checked against the supplied records. T04 maps to station 2304513. Utterances are parser test inputs, not source alarm labels.

fixtures.text: ignore the cable untwist alarm on turbine four
generator cut-in is just the wind changing, stop showing me those
fixtures.basis: 20: Large generator Cut-in; no turbine was specified.

fixtures.text: when it is icing give me one line per turbine not six
fixtures.basis: 8230: Ice detection: Low torque is the only present documented ice code. This targets that code alone; it does not assign meanings to undocumented codes or assert a six-code family.

fixtures.text: never suppress the generator winding temperature alarms
fixtures.basis: The present alarm vocabulary has no documented generator-winding-temperature code. A SCADA temperature name does not establish an alarm-code mapping.
No correction action or known alarm was requested.

fixtures.text: mute the low wind alarm on T04
group the pitch lubrication alarm on turbine 4
always tell me about high wind on number four
fixtures.basis: 8000: Windspeed too high to operate; metadata T04.

fixtures.text: don't ignore generator cut-in on turbine four
fixtures.basis: 20: Large generator Cut-in; negative suppression intent must preserve visibility.

fixtures.text: ignore fast cut-out of generator on T04
fixtures.basis: 25: Fast cut-out of generator; metadata T04.
